description:
Other polygons for Tropical cyclone, Dominica, 18 September 2017 (TC20170918DMA): 12 features merged from 2 source layers. Polygons layers that match none of the named groups. The source layer names below say what each holds. The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Damage Assessment & Related Density in the Central & Southern Parts of Dominica](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-related-density-in-the-central-southern-parts-of-dominica-2704)
- [Damage Assessment & Related Density in the Northeastern Part of Dominica](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-related-density-in-the-northeastern-part-of-dominica-2702)
- [Damage Assessment & Related Density in the Southeastern Part of Dominica](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-related-density-in-the-southeastern-part-of-dominica-2703)
- [Maria Tropical Cyclone. Damage Assessment in Portsmouth,Saint John Parish, Dominica](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/maria-tropical-cyclone-damage-assessment-in-portsmouth-saint-john-parish-dominica)
- [Maria Tropical Cyclone. Damage Assessment in Roseau South, Saint Georges Parish, Dominica](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/maria-tropical-cyclone-damage-assessment-in-roseau-south-saint-georges-parish-dominica)
- [Tropical Cyclone Maria. Damage Assessment in Marigot, Saint Andrew Parish, Dominica](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/tropical-cyclone-maria-damage-assessment-in-marigot-saint-andrew-parish-dominica)
- [Tropical Cyclone Maria. Damage Assessment in Southern Dominica](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/tropical-cyclone-maria-damage-assessment-in-southern-dominica)
- [Tropical Cyclone Maria. Damage Assessment in the Southern Part of Dominica](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/tropical-cyclone-maria-damage-assessment-in-the-southern-part-of-dominica)
- [Tropical Cyclone Maria. Damage Density in the North-western Part of Dominica](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/tropical-cyclone-maria-damage-density-in-the-north-western-part-of-dominica)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: Site_ID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = UN Building; 1 = Mosque; 2 = Hospital; 3 = Refugee / IDP Camp Building; 4 = Market; 5 = School / University; 6 = Square; 7 = Government Building; 9 = Border Crossing Point; 12 = Cemetary; 13 = Ruins; 16 = Staduim; 19 = Sewage Treatment Facility; 21 = Greenhouse; 22 = Bridge; 23 = Road; 24 = Tower; 25 = Prison; 26 = Building (General / Default); 27 = Field; 28 = Industrial Facility; 30 = Refugee / IDP Camp Site; 35 = Transport Vehicle; 40 = Military Base; 41 = Checkpoint; 45 = Suspected Mass Grave Site; 50 = AL015 - Building; 51 = AL016 - Point of interest. The decoded text is in `Site_ID_label`.

table:columns.name: AgencyID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = UNOSAT; 2 = Copernicus. The decoded text is in `AgencyID_label`.

table:columns.name: Area_m2
table:columns.description: Area in square metres, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: Area_ha
table:columns.description: Area in hectares, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: EventCode
table:columns.description: UNOSAT event code (or a Copernicus EMSR id), as recorded on the feature. It does not always equal the code of the event subcatalog.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Length
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Area
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: AgencyID_label
table:columns.description: `AgencyID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Site_ID_label
table:columns.description: `Site_ID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, as UNOSAT published it (not repaired).

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.
